description: Validate an op://vault/item/field secret reference and return only non-secret metadata (vault name, item title, field label, field type) confirming it resolves — the field VALUE is never returned. Use this to check a reference is correct before using it with op_run; do not use password_read/item_get with reveal just to check a reference exists.

secretReference.description: Secret reference to validate, in op://vault/item/field format.

name: op_check_ref
